fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s economy as a tourist town, Miami Beach civic affairs following the death of Bill Scott, and an upcoming city vote on legalizing jitney routes and its impact on transportation. Reports include Buena Vista residents protesting increased taxation and reduced municipal services, concerns about settling at the new county courthouse, and notes on police activity and arrests. A prominent feature proposes a municipal airport site in Biscayne Bay south of the new city docks, discussing access and suitability for land and water planes. The issue also contains sports coverage (boxing, football, auto races) and substantial local advertising and society/column items.
